title: Sensex, Nifty fall even as easing oil prices, buying in HDFC Bank, IT stocks help pare losses
text: Sensex, Nifty fall even as easing oil prices, buying in HDFC Bank, IT stocks help pare losses. 30-share BSE Sensex declines 120.83 points, or 0.16%, to settle at 74,781.76; 50-share NSE Nifty dips 79.70 points, or 0.34%, to end at 23,398.10
